description: This file contains a static helper class 'IOHelper' for file input/output operations related to PDF documents using the PDFsharp library, including saving, viewing, and rendering PDF documents. It also contains commented-out code for drawing visuals and rendering images, which appears to be related to WPF and PDF rendering workflows.

classes.name: IOHelper
classes.description: A static class providing helper functions for saving, displaying, and converting PDF documents, as well as rendering visuals and images (mainly commented-out sections).

methods.name: SaveToStreamOrSaveToFileAsync
methods.description: Saves a PdfDocument to a stream or file, optionally showing the document.

methods.name: SaveAndShowDocumentAsync
methods.description: Saves a PDF document to a file and opens it in the default viewer.
